g.text: `-3!` — a genuine ambiguity, PRESERVED rather than disambiguated early
— the sign is at a FORK
— only for the SINGLE-result entry point
The two `Int` readings DENOTE THE SAME NUMBER, so
collapsing them at the lexer would remove an
ambiguity rather than a meaning — and the project's
standing rule is that an ambiguity belongs in the
Removing it also had a measured cost: without the
operator spelling does not exist for it, because
The election is GLOBAL — it minimises over the whole
derivation, so it can legitimately move as the
expression grows. What the literal-domain invariant
guarantees is that no motion of it can change the
